text: Corrected VFP9 comparison to DTOC after owner steering. Installed VFP9 vs Copperfin public runtime confirms existing approved issue #5998 for typed empty Date from CTOD(\x27\x27), with SET DATE AMERICAN/CENTURY ON: VFP DTOC(...,1) eight spaces and DTOC(...) template 10 chars; Copperfin returns empty strings. Nonempty sortable control matches. Evidence comment: https://github.com/rhamenator/Project-Copperfin/issues/5998#issuecomment-5819480843. No new issue or production edit.
